Questions before choosing

Does “silver-tone” mean sterling silver?

No composition claim is made by our silver-tone label. For these comparisons, read the linked material and metal fields separately from the finish color. Where the source is unclear, we leave composition unresolved.

Does “adjustable” mean any finger size?

The retrieved adjustable labels do not give us a confirmed numerical range for every style. Ask for the range and measurement system of the selected variant; do not treat a title listing several sizes as the adjustment range of one ring.

Can I use the photos to count the included rings?

Our product images are AI-styled from linked source photos and may differ in fine detail. Confirm the packaging list and selected variant on the original listing instead of counting pieces in our images.

Are the prices current offers?

No. Product-page prices are historical Amazon references recorded October 25, 2026 and converted at ¥150 = US$1. One displayed ring has no reference price. This site accepts no orders or payments.

Which ring is hypoallergenic or waterproof?

This review has no independent testing that establishes either property for these selections. We do not turn seller marketing phrases into FUBAO guarantees.
